message.content:
{
  "maturity": "initial",
  "focalEvent": {
    "label": "Instrument-air pressure loss reported at RHOB while Utilities prepared for maintenance.",
    "detail": "At ~10:00 AM, RHOB observed an 'air-low' indication and requested Utilities attendance. Work was paused by Utilities at ~10:02 AM. The interruption origin (source vs distribution) is unknown; no injury occurred.",
    "status": "supported",
    "sourceIds": [
      "incident-description#1",
      "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
    ],
    "specialistIds": []
  },
  "nodes": [
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Utilities air gallery serves RHOB process area; local indication P-R normally shows normal pressure band.",
      "detail": "The service directory defines the Utilities air gallery as serving the RHOB process area, with a receiving header H-R and indication P-R at that station. Normal operation implies P-R is within its expected range unless an alarm triggers.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The area directory is a location index and does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time.",
      "detail": "IA-D01 explicitly states it is an index, not a current piping diagram. It cannot confirm which valves were open/closed or what pressures existed when the alarm occurred.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The point register maps AL-44 to receiving-header pressure P-R; it does not prove every supply disturbance appears in the sample export.",
      "detail": "IA-P02 states PR-12 maps AL-44 to H-R (P-R) and that this mapping is for instrumentation only. It also notes the register does not establish valve state or guarantee all disturbances are logged.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The work package cover indicates the temporary instruction attachment field was blank at issue time.",
      "detail": "IA-S02 shows WO-527-E (field execution record) is 'Blank at folder issue' and the Temporary instruction attachment field is also blank. This does not prove a service-routing change occurred or that documentation requirements were met, only that fields are empty on this copy.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "No line opening was authorized at the time of notification.",
      "detail": "IA-S01 log entry at 10:02 explicitly states 'No line opening authorized.' This indicates a procedural control (isolation/authorization) remained in place, but does not explain why pressure dropped.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The initial notification does not establish whether the interruption began at the air source, within distribution system, or at receiving equipment.",
      "detail": "IA-S01 and incident-description both state that supporting records are pending to identify the interrupting point. The log entries themselves do not specify origin (source vs line vs receiver).",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "incident-description#1",
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Desk entries do not log every field operation and do not identify the point at which air supply was interrupted.",
      "detail": "IA-S01 explicitly notes that desk entries are limited reconstructions, approximate unless stated otherwise, and lack granularity to pinpoint where in the system pressure failed.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Handwritten records are approximate unless stated otherwise; alarm occurrence time may differ from acknowledgment/export times.",
      "detail": "IA-D02 conventions state that hand-written entries (like the 10:00/10:07 timestamps) are approximations and do not automatically establish other statuses or precise timing of physical events.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "A maintenance work order being scheduled is not a record that the boundary has been released.",
      "detail": "IA-D01 states that scheduling WO-527 does not mean the maintenance release (boundary acceptance) occurred. The signature field on IA-S02 was 'not yet signed' at notification time, indicating incomplete administrative closure of the work stage.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Draft preparation alone does not satisfy distribution requirements for changed arrangements.",
      "detail": "IA-D03 Section 3.6 states that a drawing redline or draft is insufficient; the affected ECP must be revised/issued OR an approved temporary instruction attached. The blank field on IA-S02 suggests this requirement may not have been met, but evidence does not confirm whether any change occurred.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "0ff450fe-49da-4c67-8b42-35449fdad35c#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The daily briefing attendance sheet lists U-A and U-B but contains no valve-by-valve content.",
      "detail": "IA-S03 shows the briefing topic line mentions coordination, yet lacks specific operational details (e.g., which valves to isolate). This may indicate insufficient task-specific information was communicated or documented for the crew.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The training extract does not state which configuration drawing the crew saw or whether either person received a recent change briefing.",
      "detail": "IA-S03 explicitly notes that no interview covers fatigue/workload/intent, and the training extract lacks details on drawings seen or briefings received. This creates uncertainty about crew situational awareness regarding system changes.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Competence and authorization records define tasks for which a person is qualified; they do not record what that person actually observed or did on a particular job.",
      "detail": "IA-D03 Section 5.3 clarifies that qualification records (like those in IA-S03) show eligibility, not actual performance or observations during the incident. This limits inference about crew actions from authorization status alone.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "0ff450fe-49da-4c67-8b42-35449fdad35c#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "An empty form field records no value; the reason it is empty requires other evidence.",
      "detail": "IA-D02 states that a blank field (like WO-527-E or temporary instruction attachment) means 'no value' was recorded, but does not prove absence of action. The cause of emptiness must be investigated separately.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "A command, a field-position observation and a proved internal valve condition are different records.",
      "detail": "IA-D02 distinguishes these record types. The incident evidence contains commands (requests for attendance) but lacks direct observations of valve states or proven conditions at the time of failure.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "The 1SC gallery and RHOB instrument-air station are separate operating locations.",
      "detail": "IA-D01 defines these as distinct. This implies the air loss could originate in either location or at their interface, complicating origin identification without additional data.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Maintenance receives the work boundary only after its release.",
      "detail": "IA-D01 states that Utilities prepares the maintenance boundary, and Maintenance (M-A) accepts it later. At 10:00 AM, M-A's signature was not yet obtained per IA-S02, suggesting incomplete handover of control or information.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    }
  ],
  "questions": [],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The incident board currently contains only conditions and the focal event. No causal links have been proposed because evidence lacks details on valve states, system topology changes, or physical mechanisms for pressure loss (e.g., source failure vs distribution leak). The blank temporary instruction field suggests possible undocumented routing change but does not prove one occurred. Competence records confirm crew qualifications but do not show actions taken during the event.",
    "evidenceUsed": [
      "incident-description#1",
      "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1",
      "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1",
      "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1",
      "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1",
      "0ff450fe-49da-4c67-8b42-35449fdad35c#1"
    ],
    "unknowns": [
      "Origin of air loss (source vs distribution)",
      "Valve states at time of alarm",
      "Whether a service-routing change occurred despite blank field",
      "Specific actions taken by crew U-A/U-B during the event",
      "System topology and interconnections between 1SC gallery and RHOB station"
    ],
    "alternatives": [
      "Pressure loss originated at air source (compressor/dryer failure)",
      "Loss occurred in distribution line due to valve malfunction or leak",
      "Receiving equipment fault triggered alarm without upstream cause",
      "Administrative gap: undocumented routing change left system vulnerable"
    ],
    "confidence": 0.65
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "Request the full shift log (IA-S01) to extract any additional entries between 09:48 and 10:20 that might describe valve checks or communication details.",
    "Request maintenance records for WO-527-E field execution record to determine if it was ever completed, signed, or revised after issue time."
  ]
}
